messages.subject: Invitation: Autumn CLE - Warranty & Indemnity Insurance in Private M&A
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Member,

You are invited to our autumn CPD seminar, 'Warranty & Indemnity Insurance in Private M&A: market trends 2025', on 14 October at 6pm, followed by drinks. 1.5 CPD hours. Register via the link below.

Kind regards,
Holborn Law Society Events Team
